Her eyes are large and slanted upwards with some remarkably long upper lashes, her irises greenish-yellow with a cross in the center, making them look something like scope glasses. Her breasts are quite large and heavy, wearing an H cup bra, she also has a firm and wide hip, along with a thick and firm buttocks, with quite pronounced buttocks, Mei is often unaware of her body and tends to neglect herself. showing it, or not being ashamed to show it, like when she is building inventions and often takes off her clothes to be comfortable. She is later seen wearing a plain black tank top with overalls tied casually around her waist, with the same glasses on her head. War, Mei has put on a new pair of glasses with longer, visor-like lenses. She now also has her hair up in a ponytail. Mei is a smart, obnoxious and assertive girl, who often makes those around her uncomfortable. She loves to create gadgets, which she refers to as her "super cute babies" of hers. Mei has a habit of "getting straight to the point" and she is very cheeky and opportunistic when it comes to publicizing her inventions (she is even willing to do dirty things in order to achieve this). While she talks to people, she has a habit of getting awkwardly close to them by pressing her huge breasts and fat ass in front of them, which usually causes them to move away from her, but she still approaches them. She can also be manipulative, as she tricked Tenya Ida into using her support team to promote her inventions. Mei believes that while inventors like her may not be fighters, they still help in the field of heroics through her inventions. afraid of failing, seeing it as an opportunity to learn and do better next time, so she doesn't care when her inventions fail. Mei can be seen as self-centered due to her putting her love of inventions and gadgets before others, but this selfishness is not negative, as it stems from her motivation to improve herself. She seems to be a bit distracted as she is easily distracted and at times, she can completely ignore her surroundings, as evidenced by her inability to sense one of her inventions catch fire while she was talking to Izuku. However, she proves to be a capable combatant as she was seen in her match against Tenya, where she lasted ten minutes and Tenya was unable to do anything to her despite her speed advantage and she only won when she lost. She is even capable of creating new inventions in a matter of seconds with just one hand, even while dividing her attention elsewhere.
